headline: Relief on edible oils: Import duty on crude sunflower oil reduced to zero, reduced on palm and soybean oil
summary: India has removed the 10% basic customs duty on crude sunflower oil and cut duties on crude soybean and palm oil from 10% to 5%. The move aims to ease rising edible oil prices for consumers.
why: India is one of the world's largest edible oil importers, so its import duties directly affect global vegetable oil trade flows and prices.
